can_execute.note: Confirmed on a second read ('How it works', Send step). Also: 'It goes live, watches the results, and learns for next time.' The site stresses human sign-off before launch ('always with your sign-off').

multi_agent.quote: Runs the other three end to end and brings the work to your team for one-click sign-off.
multi_agent.note: Card for 'Orchestration agent · Jacq' under the heading 'Four agents put the models to work.' (Performance, Compliance, Brand and Orchestration agents). Confirmed on a second read.

integrations.note: The homepage also shows the Jacq agent working in Slack, Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot; those are left out as chat surfaces, not listed connectors.

pricing.note: No pricing page was linked. 'Analyse your brand for free' / 'Free · no card · takes about half a minute' refers to a free brand analysis, not a plan or trial.

hq_location.quote: 82 St John Street, London EC1M 4JN, United Kingdom

notes: Single long homepage with anchor navigation; there is no separate features, integrations or pricing page. The reading tool reported a Cloudflare Turnstile key in the page (bot check on the brand-analyser form) and pre-written AI prompts inside 'Claude'/'ChatGPT' buttons, which were ignored.
